user.title: Hue Active Scene
user.description: Add active-scene sensors for the Philips Hue bridges Home Assistant has already set up. There is nothing to configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

get_smart_scene.name: Get smart scene schedule
get_smart_scene.description: Return the weekly schedule a Hue smart scene holds on the bridge, in the bridge's own order and with each timeslot's raw fields. Reads only; nothing is changed.

entity_id.name: Schedule sensor
entity_id.description: Smart scene schedule sensors to read. Leave both this and Scene ID empty to read every smart scene.

scene_id.name: Scene ID
scene_id.description: Hue resource IDs of smart scenes to read, for scenes with no schedule sensor.
